test_policy.notes: Submitting SAT or ACT scores is optional and not required to receive an admission decision. For admitted international students on visas, an SAT EBRW of 560+ can also be used as proof of English proficiency.

requirements.notes: Apply through PSU's online application ($60 for international first-years). International first-year applicants need a cumulative GPA of at least 2.5 on the U.S. 4.0 scale (PSU converts it) and completed secondary school equivalent to U.S. high school; applicants below 3.0 GPA are considered by holistic review. Unofficial transcripts from non-U.S. schools can be used to get a decision; official ones are needed later. English test results are asked of admitted students. Allow four to six weeks for a decision once documents are in.

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application deadline (domestic and international undergraduates)
deadlines.notes: Application opens Aug 1, 2026; documents are due by Aug 5, 2027 and fall term begins Sept 27, 2027. PSU publishes no earlier international cutoff; allow time for the I-20 and visa.

deadlines.label: Priority date: PSU scholarships and Tuition Free Degree
deadlines.notes: March 1 is the deadline for PSU general and most departmental scholarships; international students are also automatically reviewed for the International Achievement Scholarship at admission with no separate application.

deadlines.label: Fall term enrollment confirmation priority deadline
deadlines.notes: The same date is the on-campus housing application priority deadline.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required of admitted undergraduates on non-immigrant visas. Alternatives to a test: U.S. associate degree (2.50 GPA, WR 121 plus another college writing course at C- or better), a bachelor's or higher degree from a university in Australia, English-speaking Canada, Ghana, Ireland, Kenya, New Zealand, Nigeria, South Africa, Uganda, the UK, the U.S. or Zimbabwe, citizenship of those countries with English-medium schooling, an IB diploma with 30+ points, Level 5 of the Pacific International Academy ESL program at the University of Portland (PSU's ESL partner), or PCC ESOL Level 8 with B or better. Scores must be under 2 years old; IELTS One Skill Retake is not accepted.

english.notes: Tests taken on or after Jan 21, 2026 (1-6 scale).
Academic IELTS; One Skill Retake scores not accepted.

aid.notes: All admitted undergraduate international students are automatically considered for merit scholarships of up to $10,000 per year. The International Achievement Scholarship pays $3,000 to $10,000 a year for up to 12 terms for first-years (typical entering GPA 3.25+; no separate application). The University Honors Laurels Scholarship adds up to $3,000 a year for students admitted to the Honors College. Awards apply to tuition and require 12 credits a quarter.

cost.notes: International figures are PSU's 2026-27 estimate for a 9-month year at 12 credits a quarter: tuition $25,632 ($712 a credit base rate; engineering and business pay up to $782.60), fees plus mandatory health insurance $5,775 (insurance is $1,189 a quarter), housing and meals $17,445, books $750, transportation $828 plus personal $1,383. The $13,593 resident and $36,249 nonresident amounts are PSU's all-in tuition and fees estimate at about 16 credits a term and are on a different basis
